attachment.description: Original NMEA 0183 log bytes, including all sentences and line endings.

end-time.description: Latest UTC timestamp among extracted positions with a date supplied by the log.

invalid-fix-count.description: Number of position sentences reporting no valid fix and omitted from extracted observations.

max-latitude.description: Maximum WGS84 latitude among extracted position observations.

max-longitude.description: Maximum WGS84 longitude among extracted position observations.

md5.description: MD5 hash of the original log.

mime-type.description: MIME type of the log, typically text/plain.

min-latitude.description: Minimum WGS84 latitude among extracted position observations.

min-longitude.description: Minimum WGS84 longitude among extracted position observations.

position-count.description: Number of extracted position observations; repeated sentences remain distinct observations.

sentence-count.description: Number of nonblank NMEA sentences in the log.

sentence-type.description: Sentence type, such as GGA, RMC or ZDA; proprietary sentences use their complete identifier.

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the original log.

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the original log.

size-in-bytes.description: Size of the original log in bytes.

start-time.description: Earliest UTC timestamp among extracted positions with a date supplied by the log.

talker-id.description: Two-character talker identifier from a standard NMEA sentence, such as GP or GN.

text.description: Analyst note about the log. Fix quality and sentence-specific context belong to linked geolocation observations.

unhandled-sentence-count.description: Number of sentences retained in the attachment without decoding their payload.

description: An NMEA 0183 receiver log, preserving the original sentences, file provenance, sentence and position counts, talker identifiers and derived spatial and temporal bounds. Link extracted geolocation observations using contains.
name: nmea
